simple.summary: מֶכֶר (meker) means merchandise ; also value First listed occurrence: Neh 13 16.

definitions.full: H4377. meker מֶ֫כֶר noun masculine Prov 31:10 merchandise, value ; — ׳מ absolute Neh 13:16 ; מִכְרָהּ Prov 31:10 ; מִכְרָם Num 20:19 ; probably also מִמְכָּרָיו (read מִמְּכָרָיו ) Deut 18:8 , see Di Dr; — 1 merchandise Neh 13:16 ; value, price , of water Num 20:19 (JE), compare Deut 18:8 (see above); of capable woman Prov 31:10 .
